reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed on 2026-10-10 from successful pinned Ethereum reads at block 26155000, hash 0x66b0949c52520c504b6f19d8d7924c3f0ad9eafa82828f22ba34cb759192e5aa, timestamp 2026-10-09T12:57:47Z, observed 2026-10-10T23:36:03.384Z. The native vault and queue implementation slots still resolve to 0x2b7074cf6681382b70e239063931ebe83c0f4e0a and 0xdaf6f8523d7a707d173a12041e1523fdf1373f23. STRConModule and STRCMirrorModule still resolve to 0x3c0f0b502aa7c2ed85620f7f52b8efb8049b1ecf and 0xa2cf4b9410cebcdceb3cff772ac0219f6d1105c9. STRCon recognizedValue was 62,546,085.108382 USDat-equivalent, the vault's actual USDat balance was 3,092,983.609315, and legacy mirror recognizedValue was zero. Gross identified reserves therefore total 65,639,068.717697 USDat-equivalent. totalAssets was 65,603,124.273252 and getUnvestedSurplus was 35,944.444445; their sum equals gross identified reserves exactly. The percentages use the gross reserve denominator and include unvested USDat instead of silently excluding it. The vault held 594,182.910053043150994347 STRCon. These are contract-recognized reserve weights, not independent securities/liabilities reconciliation, executable liquidation values, direct Strategy share ownership or assurance. BNB and Monad representations are not additional underlying reserves; legal and custody conclusions retain their prior unresolved scope.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gross identified Ethereum reserves = vault USDat balance + STRConModule recognizedValue = totalAssets + getUnvestedSurplus; zero legacy mirror; exact module and implementation identities pinned at block 26155000
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All operational NAV positions are identified, so unresolved composition identity exposure is zero. For the dominant STRCon slice, exact current note terms, Strategy preferred seniority, dated off-chain reconciliation, Saturn deed-of-gift execution, legal priority, default recovery and realizable liquidity are not established. Those credit/legal uncertainties remain explicit in the local mechanism overlay; zero unidentified composition is not zero financial risk. Family-level Ondo safeguards are not upgraded to Saturn holder safeguards.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The vault's current on-chain note location is verified, while issuer documentation still describes legacy off-chain STRC at Clear Street. The V2 runbook moves STRC to Alpaca, identifies Saturn Fund Ltd., Saturn Global Capital Investments Ltd. and Saturn Vault Corporation, and instructs dating a deed of gift, but its planning text does not establish executed legal rights. Whole-book custody safeguards and provider shares are unknown. Ondo family bankruptcy-remoteness and security-agent claims do not prove sUSDat holder priority against any Saturn entity.
